title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who does not hold the "admin"…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability where users without 'admin' or 'power' roles can view email notification credentials in saved searches shared with them. This occurs because the Saved Searches REST API returns these credentials in clear text when email notifications use authentication. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.3.
